name: Loretta Saintlight
original_name: ローレッタ・セントライト
source:
Loretta is a sister of the Baselbute Order, a cult that worships Lucius as a god. She schemes to resurrect him in order to bring the Empire to ruin.

She has a striking figure and appears as a gentle, refined beauty, but beneath the surface she's a weirdo with a fanatical, near-mad devotion to Lucius. She throws herself fully into serving him, but her reckless, indiscriminate methods leave a sense of unease.

She possesses the 'Creation' rune. She can bring anything non-living into existence, provided that she knows its structure. All creations disappear after a time.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/imperium/chara02.html]official website[/url]]
